python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,http.client,subprocess,sys
def check(name,ok):
 print(name+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
check("CHECKOUT_HEAD_VALID",len(head)==40)
c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
try:
 c.request("GET","/healthz")
 r=c.getresponse();status=r.status;data=r.read(30000)
finally:c.close()
check("LOCAL_HEALTHZ",status==200)
body=json.loads(data)
running=body.get("commit","")
check("RUNTIME_SHA_VALID",isinstance(running,str) and len(running)==40)
print("RUNTIME_EQUALS_CHECKOUT="+str(running==head))
print("RUNTIME_EQUALS_LATEST="+str(running=="c579553014dfc30e0c6ac765f4ab9d9527210497"))
print("CHECKOUT_EQUALS_LATEST="+str(head=="c579553014dfc30e0c6ac765f4ab9d9527210497"))
print("READ_ONLY=PASS")
PY
